context: Two staff members handle a backlog of applications
purpose: Coordinate office work; teach 番号/ご覧/審査/承知/事項/お答え

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: この申請、番号の控えはどこにありますか？
lines.en: Where is the copy of this application’s number?
lines.style: busy staffer searching for the record

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 番号は台帳をご覧ください。
lines.en: For the number, please check the ledger.
lines.style: senior officer pointing to the register

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 審査待ちの件、承知しました。
lines.style: efficient assistant confirming her task, delivery emotionally grounded and unforced

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 確認事項を読み上げます。
lines.en: I will read out the items to check.
lines.style: methodical officer running through the list

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 事項ごとにチェックしますね。
lines.en: I will check them item by item.
lines.style: diligent staffer organizing the review, spoken with a recognizable personal cadence

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 市民の方にきちんとお答えできるように。
lines.en: So we can answer citizens properly.
lines.style: principled officer stressing service quality, each word carrying genuine natural feeling

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: はい、丁寧にお答えします。
lines.style: committed assistant promising care, voice clear and distinctly their own

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: ご覧の通り、今日は件数が多い。承知の上で頼むよ。
lines.en: As you can see, there are many cases today. I am counting on you.
lines.style: tired but trusting officer rallying his colleague

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.style: crisp dependable acknowledgment from the staffer
